object_description: three differentiated buildings forming a coherent school complex
design_condition: Three offset buildings are arranged around a main square, integrating the surrounding schools, river, park, street, and east-side neighbourhood into a campus structure.

positive.statement: The three differentiated buildings have a good spatial arrangement and reinforce the campus idea.
The differentiated outdoor spaces harmonize with the space-forming buildings.
The location of the bridge in relation to the square ensures good integration with the vocational school.
The internally open and communicative building for school lessons is considered to be of high quality.
The uniform structural grid allows for a high degree of flexibility in use.

negative.statement: The adequate urban integration of the lower auditorium into the street is called into question.
The division into three buildings is viewed critically from an operational perspective because of the many timetable changes.
